column1: # DL_CHECK_P5: the 51 words of the training leaves, H1r, H2, H3 and H4 that pass 4 still wrote with Dl@ (looped sign read "us"), looked at again on the image for pass 5 (Dan Bourdeau, PR #957 review of 25 Nov 2026, point 3, carried on from the rims in pass4/DL_CHECK.tsv).

# Reference shapes (key leaf f. 99r, pass4/crops/f099r_looped_as_es_is_os_us.jpg): us = a round delta whose ascender curls back into a small loop at its top; is = an x whose right arm sweeps up into a big loop that arches over and comes down on the right. Where the transcription had "X Dl@" and the image shows the x and the loop as one sign, the pair becomes X@ (as in pass 4 for the rims).

# Images: f. 4r canvas 11, f. 15r canvas 33, f. 25r canvas 53, f. 34r canvas 71 and f. 159r canvas 325 at IIIF full size (keyleaf/IMAGE_FETCH.tsv); f. 4v canvas 12 at 2000 px (img/p2000). Line strips and word crops made by pass5/scripts/linestrips.py and pcrop.py; f. 15r and f. 25r from the pass-3 line crops; f. 34r from keyleaf/work/signs8/8_f034r_p4_unwrap.jpg.

# Looked at by Claude Opus 5.5, 27 Nov 2026, after every earlier decode had been seen (not blind; the sense of the word was known while looking). Verdict 'unresolved' = the shape could not be told at the resolution available; the word stays as written. The checks were done with AI tools and no person checked each record by hand.
